nodes.text: [i]The Quill hums. It has learned a new edge: it can format.[/i]
[i]Press [1], [2] or [3] to choose Underline, Bold or Italic, then strike a word. Words in this kitchen have weight.[/i]
[i]Press [1] [2] [3] to choose underline, bold or italic, then strike a word with the quill.[/i]
[i]Flour on every surface. The smell of bread that is not baking.[/i]
